# Lore
The Frontier is a sector on the edge of Trans-Solar Federation space, far from the crowded core worlds. It is a place of opportunity, danger, and relative freedom, where settlers, free contractors, and corporations rub shoulders under the distant authority of SolGov.
Use the pages below to learn about the major powers of the Orion Arm and the corporation that dominates so much of its industry.
